kamloops.title: Cause of Summerland wildfire under investigation as RCMP examine reports of suspicious activity
kamloops.description: The Penticton RCMP, along with neighbouring RCMP detachments, are actively patrolling areas currently within the evacuation order, checking in on properties and businesses.

kamloops.title: Seniors forced to flee B.C. wildfire found safe due to Apple AirTag, help from strangers
kamloops.description: Helen Gonzalez said she and her sister didn't know what to do until she remembered that their dog, Christy, had an Apple AirTag on her collar.

kamloops.title: Why did the ‘absolutely shocking’ B.C. wildfire intensify so fast?
kamloops.description: Starting about 15 km northwest of Summerland last Friday, the Bald Ridge wildfire quickly grew to 50 square kilometres in just three hours after it was first detected.

kamloops.title: Summerland farmers can return to wildfire evacuation zone to care for their animals
kamloops.description: Minister of Agriculture Lana Popham said the Regional District of Okanagan-Similkameen has established a pass system specifically for farmers and ranchers to relocate livestock.

kamloops.title: Latest on the Bald Range wildfire shows some fire growth expected on Monday
kamloops.description: The BC Wildfire Service said the Bald Range fire grew approximately one to 1.5 kilometres on the northwestern and southern portions on Sunday night.

kamloops.title: Why information officer kept camera rolling even as he fled B.C. wildfire with family
kamloops.description: When Erick Thompson decided he had to flee with his family as a wildfire roared towards Summerland, B.C., around 1:40 a.m. on Saturday, he also knew he had to keep filming.

kamloops.title: Evacuees slowly learn of losses from B.C. wildfire that forced thousands to flee
kamloops.description: Kyla Gaudiuso says she found out her home in Faulder, B.C., had been destroyed when she received a photo of the ridge where it once stood, completely engulfed in flames.

kamloops.title: 80-year-old woman dies while fleeing aggressive Bald Range fire near Summerland
kamloops.description: Penticton RCMP said the Meadow Valley resident was attempting to leave her home with one member of her family when she reportedly died suddenly.

all.description: This prohibition does not apply to emergency response, agriculture or commercial/industrial users who operate off-road vehicles for farming or business purposes.
